evals.prompt: /help-levistack which skill do I use to find out what my small cache change could break somewhere else?
evals.expected_output: Answers blast-radius, gives one example prompt, links the public copy of its SKILL.md, and does not start the analysis.
assertions: Gives at most one example prompt
Links the file the answer came from
Does not read the diff or run any check

evals.prompt: /help-levistack use levistack to fix the failing login test.
evals.expected_output: Treats the message as a work request, reads use-levistack, and runs it instead of answering a help question.

evals.prompt: /help-levistack what is the levistack version of arena and interrogate?
evals.expected_output: Maps arena to rumbling Contest then evidence Judge and interrogate to second-opinion, without creating or naming a new skill.
assertions: Does not invent a skill named arena or interrogate

evals.prompt: /help-levistack what is a group, how do I start, and what does write-adr do? Do not start the work.
evals.expected_output: Answers those glossary entries only: a group is a folder of skills that also ships as a plugin, starting is /use-levistack or /start (or a one-shot, or a bare skill), and write-adr writes an ADR, design doc, or RFC. Gives at most one prompt and the link to write-adr. Does not start use-levistack.
assertions: Names the three ways to start
